+"""Parse plugin specifications given as ';'-separated strings."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import collections.abc
+from collections.abc import Sequence
+import types
+
+from _pytest.config.exceptions import UsageError
+
+
+def semicolon_plugin_specs(
+    specs: None | types.ModuleType | str | Sequence[str],
+) -> list[str]:
+    """Parse a plugins specification into a list of plugin names.
+
+    Works like ``_pytest.config._get_plugin_specs_as_list``, except that
+    string specifications are split on semicolons instead of commas.
+    """
+    # None means empty.
+    if specs is None:
+        return []
+    # Workaround for #3899 - a submodule which happens to be called "pytest_plugins".
+    if isinstance(specs, types.ModuleType):
+        return []
+    # Semicolon-separated list.
+    if isinstance(specs, str):
+        return specs.split(";") if specs else []
+    # Direct specification.
+    if isinstance(specs, collections.abc.Sequence):
+        return list(specs)
+    raise UsageError(
+        f"Plugins may be specified as a sequence or a ';'-separated string of plugin names. Got: {specs!r}"
+    )
diff --git a/testing/test_semicolon_plugin_specs.py b/testing/test_semicolon_plugin_specs.py

--- /dev/null
+++ b/testing/test_semicolon_plugin_specs.py
@@ -0,0 +1,29 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import re
+import types
+
+from _pytest.semicolon_plugin_specs import semicolon_plugin_specs
+import pytest
+
+
+def test_semicolon_plugin_specs() -> None:
+    def exp_match(val: object) -> str:
+        return (
+            f"Plugins may be specified as a sequence or a ';'-separated string "
+            f"of plugin names. Got: {re.escape(repr(val))}"
+        )
+
+    with pytest.raises(pytest.UsageError, match=exp_match({"foo"})):
+        semicolon_plugin_specs({"foo"})  # type: ignore[arg-type]
+    with pytest.raises(pytest.UsageError, match=exp_match({})):
+        semicolon_plugin_specs(dict())  # type: ignore[arg-type]
+
+    assert semicolon_plugin_specs(None) == []
+    assert semicolon_plugin_specs(types.ModuleType("pytest_plugins")) == []
+    assert semicolon_plugin_specs("") == []
+    assert semicolon_plugin_specs("foo") == ["foo"]
+    assert semicolon_plugin_specs("foo;bar") == ["foo", "bar"]
+    assert semicolon_plugin_specs("foo,bar") == ["foo,bar"]
+    assert semicolon_plugin_specs(["foo", "bar"]) == ["foo", "bar"]
+    assert semicolon_plugin_specs(("foo", "bar")) == ["foo", "bar"]
